items.title: Greg Thomas interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 11, 2014
items.q: I once asked Albert Murray if James Baldwin was an influence on him. And he said, “Yes. He was an influence. He influenced me in what not to do.”

ctx.x: called him a jazz musician. He was playing instrumental pop music and it was very pleasant and stuff. So let’s just call Kenny G an instrumental pop musician.

Right. And that’s okay. But there are people who get confused. Why do they get confused? Because you have radio stations that were playing things that they called jazz but that really wasn’t jazz. Now you’ve got certain stations that are influenced more, like WRVR in New York in the late 70s that played jazz, what we call jazz, but they also played fusion, which is like a combination of jazz with rock and other elements. Okay. I’m not a purist though. I mean that’s why I say it’s okay if you want to play…
Yeah. You can learn something from things you don’t like.
